about_the_game:
"Yesterday never truly left."

"A Man's Work" is a short, story-driven psychological horror set in 2001. During a cold, snowy winter, Nikolay Sokolov, a rising Russian horror film actor, returns to his late father’s apartment to sort through his belongings and memories. His father was a hardworking, quiet man who never spoke of the past, especially the tragedy that tore their family apart.

Storyline

Nikolay Sokolov, a famous Russian actor known for his chilling roles in horror films, hasn’t returned to his late father’s apartment for two years. Now, he comes back to stay in the city while preparing for his next project, a horror film more intense and demanding than anything he has done before.

As Nikolay dives deeper, he confronts more than just his father’s past. When his father died, he was overcome with grief, but guilt lingers as well, for he had broken off his relationship with his father after a bitter conflict, a mistake he can’t forgive himself for. While the memories of the apartment creep into his life, merging with the darkness of the film he’s about to make, can he endure a nightmare he brought upon himself?

Immerse yourself in an atmospheric world where tension and reality collide, and every moment pulls the mind and spirit to the edge of perception and fear. Nothing here is as it seems, and every choice carries consequences beyond understanding.

What awaits you:

  • The game’s main genre is walking simulator.

  • An early-2000s inspired aesthetic.

  • Realism in gameplay and visuals.

  • Experience a cinematic horror where realistic environments and film-inspired visuals come together.

  • The immersive sound design and atmospheric soundtrack draw you in, layering tension to the world.

  • Actions, decisions, and found recordings weave the story of a chilling supernatural past.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of violence that may negatively affect the viewer’s psychological state. Some content may be inappropriate for certain age groups. It is advised to apply suitable age restrictions for the intended audience.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 580
